note: Recast from the redescription of the soldier of Thai specimens by Ahmad (1965), original in English; the original records the soldier only, the alate and worker not being described; figure 44 (head and pronotum, labrum, postmentum, antenna) is not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow with a reddish tinge; labrum brown; mandibles dark brown, paler at the base; antenna pale brown, uniform in colour; pronotum yellow. Head sparsely hairy; labrum with a row of bristles along both lateral margins and the apex; postmentum with two pairs of bristles anteriorly; pronotum with scattered bristles on the margins and the disc. Head rectangular; labrum longer than wide, sides parallel, apex narrowly rounded; mandibles stout and thick, curved apically, left mandible with a well-developed lateral tooth anterior to the middle, right mandible with an indistinct tooth in about the middle. Postmentum elongate, about 2.5 times as long as wide, sides parallel, widest in the apical quarter; antenna 16 segments, segment 2 slightly longer than 3, segment 4 shortest. Pronotum longer than half its width, anterior margin convex with an indistinct median notch, posterior margin slightly concave medially. Measurements of 10 soldiers: head length (to the lateral mandible base) 1.82—1.89 (mean 1.86) mm, head width (at the lateral mandible base) 0.96—1.01 (0.99) mm, head width at the posterior end of the antennal carina 1.14—1.22 (1.19) mm, maximum head width 1.19—1.30 (1.24) mm, left mandible length 0.88—0.93 (0.91) mm, distance from the left mandibular tooth to the apex 0.33—0.36 (0.35) mm, postmentum length 1.17—1.30 (1.22) mm, postmentum width 0.45—0.52 (0.49) mm, pronotum length 0.52—0.57 (0.53) mm, pronotum width 0.85—0.93 (0.90) mm.
